comparison.objective: Phase and mesh two gears; unlike calibrating damping from repeated impacts.
comparison.physical_skill: Knob rotation for tooth alignment plus bimanual axial gear insertion versus unlocking, fine collar rotation, relocking, and cycle observation.
comparison.success_condition: Teeth aligned and small gear physically meshed after release versus two repeatable non-bottoming stops and retained setting.
comparison.reason: Shared rotation and stabilization are generic; gear phasing/insertion tests a different ability from dynamic-response tuning. Detailed thresholds are absent.
